BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Warnick, Dozier, Frame, Rolfes, Saldaña, Salomon, Shewmake, and J. Wilson

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on State Government & Elections.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the state cactus; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The pediocactus nigrispinus, more commonly known as the basalt cactus, snowball cactus, hedgehog cactus, or Columbia Plateau cactus, is hereby designated as the official cactus of the state of Washington.
